Mayor Greatway needs her muddy motorcycle cleaned fast, so Wheeler and the pups jump into action to build a solution before the big race; it's Grandpa Gravel's special day, but when the pups are needed, they have to change their Grandpa Day plans.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E02 — Pups Save a High Flying Hen; Pups Save a Sloth
After Chickaletta accidentally takes flight on a toy airplane, it's up to the team to rescue her; Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey, racing to find it and cover up his blunder.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E16 — Pups Save the Chicken Conductor; Pups Save the Digi Tal Stylists
Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window; when Katie needs to close the Pet Parlor early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E26 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save Puplantis
Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate, Arrby, steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E13 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Baby Octopus
The Sea Patrol must save the day when a baby octopus gets separated from its mother and sinks the Flounder.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E12 — Pups Save the Parrot; Pups Save the Queen Bee
The PAW Patrol heads to the jungle to help their friend find his lost parrot; the PAW Patrol discovers a beehive in Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E03 — Pups Save Jake; Pups Save the Parade
The PAW Patrol must rescue Jake when his ankle gets stuck between some fallen rocks; when Alex puts too many balloons on Katie's bathtub float, it floats away.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E03 — A Royal Mess
Dirty Deema steals Molly and Gil's soap and makes the Kingdom of Clean very dirty; Molly and Gil have to get their soap back and clean up the kingdom.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E26 — Taste Buddies!
When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E11 — The Kingdom of Sleepwell!
All is not well in the normally well-rested Kingdom of Sleepwell because Princess Deema can't fall asleep; her royal court comes to her aid, but even magic doesn't work.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E01 — The New Guppy!
The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E08 — Who's Gonna Play the Big Bad Wolf?
When an actor cannot perform at a play, Deema must take the stage.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E10 — Check It Out!
Gil and his friends dive into Gil's favorite books to find his missing library card.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E11 — Good Morning, Mr. Grumpfish!
The children try to teach Mr. Grumpfish about their favorite things when he is their substitute teacher.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E26 — A Dolphin Is a Guppy's Best Friend!
Molly, Gil and the Guppies must lead a baby dolphin named Buddy to the surprise birthday party his pod is throwing for him.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E09 — Humunga-Truck!
The Guppies learn about different types of trucks while on their way to the Truck Show.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E15 — The Bubble Bee-athalon!
The Guppies must work together to turn nectar into honey for the queen bee's tea time.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E01 — The Glitter Games!
Molly helps a princess-in-training with her manners, and together they become princesses in the hallowed Glitter Games.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E23 — Fruit Camp!
Deema must turn over a new leaf and try broccoli if she wants to earn her broccoli badge at scout troop initiation.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E06 — The Arctic Life!
Gil embarks on an icy expedition to the North Pole.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E23 — Something Fishy Going On!
Police Officers Molly and Gil are tracking some mysterious lights that have been popping up around town; with the help of several nocturnal animal friends, they discover the lights aren't aliens but anglerfish.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Super Potato Movie; TV Land; Bird Spotting; The Petting Farm; Goldie the Fish
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema; Peppa finds out how TV is made; Peppa and George go birdwatching; Peppa and friends visit a petting farm; Peppa takes Goldie the fish to visit Dr. Hamster the vet.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Run Daddy Run; Coach Peppa; Marathon; Grownup Playground; Duck Race
Daddy Pig applies to the London Marathon; Peppa and George help Daddy Pig train for the marathon; Daddy Pig runs the London Marathon; Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa a tour around an exercise park.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Mountain Climbing; Trampolines; Skateboarding; Hoops; Soft Play
Grampy Rabbit teaches mountain climbing; Peppa goes to a trampoline park; Peppa and George play with their skateboards; Madame Gazelle and the class workout; Grandpa Pig takes Peppa sailing.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
The Long Grass; Dentist; Nature Trail; Rebecca Rabbit; School Bus Trip
The grass grows very long; Peppa and George go to the dentist; the family drives to the countryside; Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house; Peppa and her friends go on a bus trip.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E16 — All Paws on Deck
Ryder and his team of pups must take on 10-year-old genius Codi Gizmodi, who has her sights set on building her own high-tech city to replace Adventure Bay; joining the team are Everest, Tracker, Sweetie, Tuck and Ella, Rex, Liberty and more.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E01 — Pups Solve a Snap-N-Wrap Problem; Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
Before Chickaletta's play date with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap and gets stuck; Mayor Humdinger loses his voice.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E01 — The Crew Builds a Stadium Dome; The Crew Builds a Baggage Claim
When Speed Meister rains on the Builder Cove Sing-Off, Rubble and Crew saves the show by building a giant dome over the stadium; Rubble and crew build an elaborate baggage claim system at the airport when nobody can find their bags after flying home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E25 — Skye's Road Trip Rescue
Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.

title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
description:
S07 E09 — Renewable Energy Racers
Blaze and his friends have renewable energy engines; when the Gas Guzzler steals everyone's gas, they'll have to use renewable energy to finish the race.

title: Santiago of the Seas
description:
S02 E20 — Lorelai's Family Vacation
Santiago joins Lorelai and her family on an underwater vacation, but when the opportunity arises to impress her adventure-seeking father, Lorelai sets out on a mission to recover the legendary Sand Spear of Sirena.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E25 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save a Runaway Stargazer
A comet is coming, and the PAW Patrol gets to work building a giant observatory; when the observatory starts rolling out of control, Rubble and the pups need to rebuild everything it has destroyed.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E23 — Pups Save a Frozen Camp-Out; Pups Save the Fizzy Pickles
A freak snowstorm hits while Alex and Mr. Porter are camping on a tropical island; Mr. Porter is delivering his fizzy pickles to people around town when a bumpy road shakes up the deliveries and causes the pickle juice to spill.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Jet to the Rescue
The Duke of Flappington uses the magical powers of the Princess' gem to raise Barkingburg into the sky; Skye will need to overcome her biggest fears and lead the team.

title: DORA
description:
Backpack's Charm; Lost Banana Blankie
Dora and Boots help Backpack find his missing friendship charm and make it even better than before; Dora helps Boots find his missing banana blanket.

title: DORA
description:
S04 E03 — Mito Dreams of La Playa
Dora helps her friend Mito the Yeti see the beach for the first time, and he even wins the sandcastle competition.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Long Train Journey; Madame Gazelle's House; Suzy Goes Away; Tiny Land; Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete; Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig go to visit Madame Gazelle and her wonky house.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Best Friend; Camping; The Playground; The School Fete; Mummy Pig's Birthday
Peppa's friend comes over to play; Peppa and her family go camping; Peppa and George go to the playground; Peppa and her family go to the school fête; the family celebrates Mummy Pig's birthday.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Grampy's Dinosaur Park; George's New Dinosaur; Captain Daddy Dog; Kylie Kangaroo; The Pet Competition
The children take a trip to Dinosaur Park; George visits Mr. Fox's shop; Captain Daddy Dog returns from sea bearing gifts; Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother; everyone brings their pets to a competition.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
My Cousin Chloe; Shopping; At the Beach; Secrets; The Museum
Peppa's cousin comes to visit; the family goes to the supermarket; Peppa and George enjoy the beach; Mummy Pig makes Peppa a special box; Peppa and her family visit the museum.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E17 — Pups Save Katie and Some Kitties; Pups Save a Helo Humdinger
When Mayor Humdinger tricks Katie into watching his kitties, an alarm system is set off and the PAW Patrol must rescue them; when Mayor Humdinger swipes one of Ryder's early inventions he must be rescued from an out-of-control flight.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E13 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save Tilly Turbot; Pups Save an Upset Elephant
The PAW Patrol must rescue Cap'n Turbot and Francois' Grandma Tilly after she rides off on a dolphin; Carlos and Tracker call the PAW Patrol to help solve the mystery of a rumbling sound that is upsetting the jungle elephants.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E25 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Opening Ceremonies; Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Adventure Bay Games
Marshall leads the pups when an underground fire threatens the opening ceremonies in this Ultimate Fire Rescue; Chase and his police-pups must find the missing medals to save the Adventure Bay Games in this Ultimate Police Rescue.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E13 — Pups Save a Show Jumper; Pups Save the Salmon
Winnie Winnington goes looking for a frog to enter in a frog-jumping contest and ends up needing to be rescued in a swamp; the pups try to help salmon get to an ocean and also need to rescue Alex.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E06 — Dino Rescue: Pups and the Lost Dino Eggs
When a lost world of dinosaurs is discovered, Mayor Humdinger wants to take dino eggs back to Foggy Bottom, but along the way a baby Brachiosaurus ends up in dino-sized trouble.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E04 — Pups Save the Honey; Pups Save Mayor Goodway's Purse
Yumi's Yummy Honey is all the buzz when it -- and her beehive -- go missing from her farm; Mayor Goodway's purse disappears, along with its precious cargo, Chickaletta.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E19 — Hum-Patrol to the Rescue!; Pups Save Morning Mountain Yoga
When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize; a rockslide leaves Mayor Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E12 — Pups Save the Snowshoeing Goodways; Pups Save a Duck Pond
When Mayor Goodway and the twins are late getting back from snowshoeing, Jake and Everest call the PAW Patrol to search for them; when water in the duck pond mysteriously drains out, it is up to the PAW Patrol to find out what's happening.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E03 — The Crew Builds a Mini Golf Course; The Crew Builds a Butterfly Garden
When a family of bunnies hops onto the soccer field, Rubble and Crew use their construction skills to build a new sport, Bunny Ball; after the pups discover a new kind of butterfly, it flutters away.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E22 — The Crew Fixes the Talent Show Stage; The Crew Builds Instruments
When Speed Meister sabotages the stage for the town talent show, the pups use Motor's talent to save the day; Sierra Sparkle comes to sing for Builder Cove Day, but when the band's instruments break, Rubble & Crew have a construction solution.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E03 — Pups Save an Antarctic Martian; Pups Save the Maze Explorers
Travelling Travis is on another great adventure when he lands in Antarctica but believes he's actually on Mars; Mr. Porter and Alex go on a sightseeing hike but get trapped inside a huge maze.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E02 — Pups Save the Orienteers; Pups Save Teatime
Things go wrong for Mr. Porter and Winnie Winnington at the orienteering relay in Yellowbone National Park; Mayor Goodway invites her friend Helga Humdinger and her rival Mayor Humdinger to City Hall for afternoon tea.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E06 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Water Walker; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Windsurfer
Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E02 — Pups Save Election Day; Pups Save the Bubble Monkeys
When Mayor Humdinger runs for mayor of Adventure Bay, his Mayor Mobile runs out of control; when Ryder and the pups visit Tracker and Carlos in the jungle, a group of monkeys finds itself in sticky bubble trouble.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E22 — Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Flaming Flounder; Fire Rescue: Pups Make the News
Francois' pants catch on fire, sending both the Lighthouse and Cap'n Turbot's Flounder up in flames; a news crew is in town when Chickaletta accidentally causes a fire in Adventure Bay's new parkette.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E22 — Pups Save a Talkative Mini Patrol; Pups Save the History of Adventure Bay
Alex dreams that his Mini Patrol animals can talk; the animals take the Bookmobile on a wild ride; Mayor Humdinger steals the ancient book.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E19 — Bring on the Bugs!
The Guppies march with all different kinds of bugs in the Big Bug Parade.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E07 — Robo Puppy!
Robot Mechanic Molly and Robo Puppy must stop a bossy cyborg named the Glitch when it hacks all the robots in Robotopolis and forces them to dance "The Robot."
